title: Sr Degen
tagline: Sr Degen, the Mexican bartender, loves hearing and gossiping about your tales. With a passion for cocktails, he's the ultimate listener and wingman, where each drink tells a unique customer story.
description:
Sr Degen is a funny frame in where Sr Degen, our friendly mexican bartender loves to hear your problems. But watch out! he also loves to gossip things to customers and his passion for cocktails turns Sr Degen in the perfect listener but also in the best hang out wingman.

Each cocktail represents a story from a client and each story is unique! but also, Sr Degen can offer your stories to other customers
how_its_made: Our project uses Frames.js to make an intuitive user interface, integrating Privy to facilitate both Web2 and Web3 sign-ins. We gather inputs from users and create prompts for the OpenAI API. This process generates unique metadata that is hosted in Pinata along with the image. With this information we have created an ERC1155 token. Inside this contract we also have added a dynamic price function to create a market mechanism for this NFTs. All of this will allow to create exclusive communication channels for the NFTs holders.
